reference_sql:
WITH lines_per_order AS (
  SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT n_lines, COUNT(*) AS n_orders
FROM lines_per_order
GROUP BY n_lines
